items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I think Mort was the road manager then.

ctx.x: show up for rehearsal. So he was mad... Charlie was madder than a wet hen. When I came in the theatre, he said, "Where you been?!" I said, "I was trying to find a place to stay? Why? Did you have a place for me to stay?" So he said, "Oh... What's the matter? Why didn't you stay at the hotel like everybody else?" I said, "Well, I didn't have no reservation there." So... I think Mort was the road manager then. So he said...
